GTA VI Limited Edition DualSense Wireless Controllers Revealed

September 3rd, 2026 / Niraj Shah / News
0
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 1:30
Instaread

A pair of new limited-edition DualSense wireless  controllers drawing inspiration from Grand Theft Auto VI has been unveiled. Available in black and white variants, each model embodies the spirit of Vice City, from sunny coastal days to energetic urban nights. Both versions boast an iridescent, color-shifting coating that blends the tones of a Vice City sunset with the radiance of neon lights.

Revealed at PlayStation’s State of Play, both controllers feature custom palm tree details molded directly into the  controller, adding a unique tactile element alongside official Grand Theft Auto VI branding.  

CompareHandheld Consoles

The DualSense Wireless Controller – Grand Theft Auto VI White Limited Edition

This version embodies Vice City at daybreak, from its white sands and pastel skies to all its laid-back glamour.  The white version will be available in limited quantities globally at direct.playstation.com and at participating retailers.

The DualSense Wireless Controller – Grand Theft Auto VI Black Limited Edition

The black version captures the energy of Vice City’s iconic nightlife. Once again, this edition will be available in limited quantities exclusively through direct.playstation.com where available and through select retailers.

Both limited-edition DualSense wireless controllers will launch starting on 19th November 2026 for a recommended retail price of:

ReadStrategy Guides

  • $84.99 USD
  • ¥12,480 (including tax)
  • €84.99 EURO
  • £74.99 GBP

Pre-Order Purchase Information

Starting on 10th September at 7:00am PT/10:00am ET in the U.S., and 10:00am local time in the U.K., France, Germany, Austria, Spain, Italy, Netherlands, Belgium, and Luxembourg, players will be able to pre-order DualSense Wireless Controller – Grand Theft Auto VI Black Limited Edition and White Limited Edition through direct.playstation.com in limited quantities. In Portugal, players can pre-order through playstation.com/store/hardware.
